plugins.name: cc-knowledge
plugins.description: Lookup skill plus harness-optimized reference files for authoring and configuring Claude Code — skills, subagents, hooks, slash commands, MCP, plugins, CLAUDE.md memory, and settings — plus a read-only expert agent that replaces the built-in claude-code-guide. Retrieves only the relevant section into context.

plugins.name: coding-toolbox
plugins.description: Mechanically enforces the Interaction axis on Stop and blocks non-UTF-8 file operations; the golden behavior rules doc is available as an opt-in project rule via the setup-rules skill.

plugins.name: universal-format
plugins.description: Silently auto-formats just-written Shell/Java/Kotlin/JS-TS/Python/Go/Rust files after Write/Edit via each language's standard formatter (no-op when absent), honoring .editorconfig and tool-native configs.

plugins.name: memory-enhancement
plugins.description: A dream skill that runs a natural-language-triggered, four-phase memory-consolidation cycle over this project's auto-memory files (orient, gather signal from recent session transcripts, consolidate merging duplicates/dropping stale entries/resolving contradictions, update the MEMORY.md index under its 200-line load cutoff), compressing touched detail files caveman-style via cc-knowledge's cc-compress; a turn-end/session-start mods hook pair flags and nudges the next session to run one, gated by the auto_dream toggle (default true).

plugins.name: npm-automations
plugins.description: Runs an async lockfile-frozen install (npm ci / pnpm install --frozen-lockfile / yarn install --frozen-lockfile, picked by whichever lockfile is present) when a project is entered via EnterWorktree (toggle: npm_ci_on_worktree), and an async, dependency-scoped install whenever a package.json's dependencies actually change (toggle: npm_install_on_package_change) — moved out of coding-toolbox to centralize npm-lifecycle automation hooks.

plugins.name: taskflow
plugins.description: Spec-driven design & delivery pipeline. /taskflow:build-task orchestrates two dynamic workflows: design-to-spec (explore, draft, review, spec) and spec-driven-delivery (plan, wave-parallel implement in isolated worktrees, per-wave merge, combined review, fix application). /taskflow:changes-audit runs the review pass standalone with optional --fix.

plugins.name: rc-enhancement
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that injects one critical must-follow rule: all user interaction goes through the AskUserQuestion tool — never end a turn with a plain-text question, and capture free-text answers via the tool's Other option alongside an Abort/Cancel option.
